title: Logs Explorer
description: pino JSON from every container in the stack, parsed into fields. Use the query snippets below as a starting point.

options.content:
`service` is the compose service name and `project` scopes to this stack. pino emits one JSON object per line, so every field is filterable; `level` and `status` are promoted to labels by Alloy, everything else is a query-time `| json` field.

| Intent | LogsQL |
|---|---|
| Everything the app logged | `{project="workspace-stack", service="app"}` |
| Errors only | `{project="workspace-stack", level=~"40\|50\|60"}` |
| One trace, end to end | `{project="workspace-stack"} \| json \| trace_id="<32-hex>"` |
| Slow requests | `{project="workspace-stack"} \| json \| durationMs > 1000` |
| 5xx responses | `{project="workspace-stack", status=~"5.."}` |
| Auth activity | `{project="workspace-stack", service="app"} \| json \| url=~".*/api/v1/auth.*"` |
| Database / OpenFGA noise | `{project="workspace-stack", service=~"postgres\|openfga"}` |

Sampled with `| logfmt`, parsed with `| json`, filtered with `|= "needle"`, de-noised with `| drop __error__, __error_details__`.
